name: Scan Docker Image for Vulnerabilities (engineer rendition)
description: Perform a Trivy-based security scan on a specified Docker image to identify high and critical vulnerabilities. Reported for the engineer who will act on the result.

reporting.expectedOutput: Security scan summary, complete list of detected vulnerabilities with technical detail, evidence and remediation steps

notes: One of four sibling intents (technical, management, compliance, external) that differ only in actor.role, reporting.profile and expectedOutput. Target, parameters and criteria are identical, so all four produce the same canonical facts (25 findings, 21 HIGH, 4 CRITICAL) and differ only in rendition. The technical profile keeps all 25 findings with no omissions: findingsOmitted = 0, and each carries CVE identifiers, affected package versions, severity, and remediation paths. Against the trivy-docker-image skill: iso27001 and dora resolve to assessed (evidence bears on 2 of 6 recorded ISO 27001 requirements — A.8.8 technical vulnerability management and A.8.9 configuration management — and on 1 of 4 DORA requirements, Art. 10 ICT vulnerability detection); linddun resolves to declaredNotAssessed, since no requirement under it is evaluable by an image scanner; internal_baseimage_policy:v4 resolves to unrecognised. regulatoryCoverage.complete is therefore false.
